ValidationRule.description: Branch number should be 6 digit numeric for Payment currencies AUD and NZD
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Branch_Number_BSB_Sort_Code__c), Payment_Details_Added_Manually__c, $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Admin - Freight", $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Admin - QCC", $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Admin - SND", OR( ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Payment (EFT)'), ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Ticket Refund EFT') ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Original_Currency__c, 'AUD Australian Dollar'), ISPICKVAL(Original_Currency__c, 'NZD New Zealand Dollar') ), OR(ISBLANK(Branch_Number_BSB_Sort_Code__c), NOT(REGEX(Branch_Number_BSB_Sort_Code__c, '^[0-9]{6}$'))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Branch number should be 6 digits for the selected country
